updates.title: New Built-in Entra Role: SOC Identity Responder
updates.summary: Microsoft introduced a new built-in Entra role called SOC Identity Responder to enable security teams to perform identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender without requiring multiple high-privilege roles. This least-privilege approach reduces delays during incident response and decreases dependency on identity administrators.

updates.title: External Users Can Be Directly Assigned to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users not yet in the directory to access packages using email addresses, automatically inviting them as guest users with governance controls. This streamlines external access provisioning and ensures consistent governance enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Generally Available
updates.summary: Entra Backup and Recovery is now fully available as a built-in service that automatically backs up and enables restoration of critical directory objects including users, groups, applications, and Conditional Access policies. Admins can recover from accidental changes or malicious updates without manual intervention.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Conditional Access now supports targeting and protecting AI agents with user accounts through custom security attributes, agent risk evaluation, and compliance requirements. Administrators can apply least-privilege policies to agents with the same precision as human users.

updates.title: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: Organizations can now configure SAML identity provider federation without requiring email domain matching, allowing external users to authenticate using IdP-managed credentials regardless of their email domain. This simplifies multi-tenant federation and streamlines external identity scenarios.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs Generally Available in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs are now available in the US Government cloud environment, providing standards-based identity lifecycle management for users and groups in Microsoft Entra. This enables automated provisioning workflows consistent with commercial cloud deployments.

updates.title: BYOD Support for Windows Clients Using Entra Registration
updates.summary: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) support for Windows clients using Entra-registered devices is now generally available, allowing users to access corporate resources from personal devices with granular network access controls. Administrators can assign traffic profiles to enable secure resource access without requiring Azure AD join.

updates.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Microsoft Authenticator App
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now detects and blocks work or school accounts on rooted or jailbroken devices, enforcing security by default to prevent compromised device access. Users on non-compliant devices must migrate to compliant devices to continue using work accounts in Authenticator.

updates.title: AD Group Enforcement for Cloud Sync Provisioning
updates.summary: Organizations can now designate specific Active Directory groups to only accept changes through Entra cloud sync, blocking unauthorized modifications made outside Entra. This prevents group drift and maintains consistency between cloud and on-premises directory management.

updates.title: Improved Kerberos Key Rotation Reliability for Incoming Trust Referrals
updates.summary: Entra Kerberos key rotation now handles incoming trust referral flows more reliably by validating with both primary and secondary keys, eliminating authentication failures during rotation. This improves stability for hybrid environments with complex trust relationships.

updates.title: DLP File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention now supports automatic file quarantine for SharePoint and OneDrive, moving sensitive files to an admin-controlled restricted location when policies trigger. This immediately revokes user access while preserving files for investigation, adding enforcement capabilities beyond policies.

updates.title: DLP Restrictions for External Emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now blocks Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails originating from external senders, mitigating prompt injection and data leakage risks. This provides real-time control over sensitive data exposure through AI-powered applications.

updates.title: DLP Protection for External Web Search in Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches, blocking disclosure of protected content to public search engines. This control addresses risks from data leakage and oversharing in generative AI workflows.

updates.title: DLP Restriction for Copilot Processing Sensitivity-Labeled Files Now Supports All Storage Locations
updates.summary: The DLP policy preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing sensitivity-labeled files now applies regardless of file storage location (previously limited to specific locations). This provides consistent data protection enforcement across Word, Excel, and PowerPoint regardless of where files are stored.

updates.title: DLP and Auto-labeling Extended to Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection auto-labeling now extend to non-Microsoft platforms including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. Organizations can enforce data protection policies consistently across multi-cloud environments with condition and action support varying by application.

updates.title: Auto-labeling of SharePoint Files to Match Library Default Labels
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now enables automatic sensitivity labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest without relying on manual user action, enabling secure-by-default configurations.

updates.title: Auto-labeling Capacity Increased for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft increased maximum auto-labeling capacity from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day for SharePoint and OneDrive. This five-fold increase enables organizations to label and protect significantly more data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps before Copilot deployments.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations Now Integrates Endpoint DLP Evidence
updates.summary: Data Security Investigations can now query evidence captured by endpoint DLP policies on onboarded devices, enabling aggregate analysis of exfiltration events instead of per-alert triage. This integration streamlines investigation workflows by correlating endpoint DLP signals with centralized data security analysis.

updates.title: DLP Event Data Now Enriches Microsoft Defender Alert Graph API
updates.summary: The Graph API for Defender alerts is now enriched with DLP event data, enabling easy integration with SIEM tools, automated workflows, and custom reports. Previously DLP details required separate Management API queries; this consolidation simplifies correlation and reduces integration complexity.

updates.title: Data Security Triage Agent Enhancements in Insider Risk Management
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management's Data Security Triage Agent now includes improved user risk summaries and activity explorer pattern analysis to enhance investigation accuracy and decision quality. These enhancements help analysts better understand and contextualize insider risk signals with pseudonymization by default.
